legalName: Motion to Void a First Marijuana, Synthetic Drug or Salvia Possession Conviction and Seal the Records (KRS 218A.276)
publicName: Void and seal a first Kentucky marijuana or synthetic drug possession conviction
compositeReliefNote: The statutory remedy is composite: under KRS 218A.276(8) the court may void the conviction, and under (9) it shall then order the records sealed. "sealing" is carried as the single relief noun because it is the operative relief on the records; the voiding is carried as presentation.reliefActionVerb ("void and seal"). No source read for this track supplies a one-word name for the composite remedy.
documentTitleFull: MOTION TO VOID CONVICTION AND SEAL RECORDS PURSUANT TO KRS 218A.276
courtCaption: {courtLevel} COURT — {county} COUNTY, COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY — CASE NO. {caseNumber}
courtCaptionNote: Token pattern only. The registry records that the motion "is made in the original criminal case" and is filed "as motion type SA with no summons issued", so the caption is the caption of the existing criminal case rather than a new one. No source read for this track states an accepted caption, a party-role line, or a court-name format. Every token is filled only from the participant's own screening answers (vmjCourtLevel, vmjCounty, vmjCaseNumber). Accepted caption is an open counsel flag.

rationale: The registry declares outputStrategy and outputStrategyDeclared 'custom_pleading' for this track with compositionMode null and units[] empty, so this is a single-document controlled pleading, not a composed route.

packetSet.components lists three components: a required primary filing (custom_pleading), a required proposed order that is an official PDF fill of AOC-334, and a required certificate of service (custom_pleading). Lane C drafts the two custom-pleading components and drafts nothing for AOC-334.

AOC-334 is the same official order form the KRS 218A.275 track tenders; the registry records the identical officialFormId and officialSourceUrl on both. It is recorded as a mandatory official-form dependency and handed to the official-PDF overlay lane.

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: The fixed offence list: possession of marijuana under KRS 218A.1422, synthetic drugs under KRS 218A.1430, or salvia under KRS 218A.1451.
After satisfactory completion of treatment, probation or other sentence on a first conviction on the subsection (1) list, the court may void the conviction.
On voiding, the court shall order the records sealed. Records excepted under KRS 27A.099 are not sealed.
The proceedings may not be used against the defendant except to determine eligibility, and the participant need not disclose them.
The five-year period does not apply where the conviction was voided under KRS 218A.276(8). Carried as a packet instruction for onward routing, not as relief requested in this motion.

verificationStatute.description: No verification statute is cited because the motion is not verified. The registry states in terms: notarization "none required. The motion is not verified." This is the affirmative-absence case, distinct from the ND config's unknown-verification case: there the source was silent and the requirement was flagged as unconfirmed; here the source states there is none. No verification or notarization block is rendered.

includeProposedOrderReason: A proposed order IS required on this track and IS tendered with the motion — but it is official form AOC-334, Order Voiding Conviction and Sealing Records, Rev. 1-22, not a drafted document. Lane C drafts no official forms. Recorded as a mandatory official-form dependency at components/ky_void_seal_marijuana_synthetic_salvia-proposed-order-2/dependency.json and handed to the official-PDF overlay lane. includeProposedOrder is false because this config drafts no order text, not because no order is filed.
includeCertificateOfServiceReason: Required component in the registry packet set (role certificate_of_service, requirement required, outputStrategy custom_pleading). The registry states: "No summons issues. The movant serves the prosecuting attorney and files a certificate of service."
serviceNote: By mail or hand delivery on the county or Commonwealth's attorney that prosecuted the case.
qaProhibitedTermsNote: 'expungement' and its variants are barred because this remedy is voiding and sealing, and expungement is a separate downstream route under KRS 431.078(2) named in participant copy only. 'decriminalized' and 'legalized' are barred because no source read for this track says anything about the current legal status of marijuana, synthetic drugs or salvia in Kentucky; the eligible-offence list is fixed by KRS 218A.276(1) and nothing beyond it may be argued.

Setting it true on a Kentucky track puts Pennsylvania into a Kentucky motion. The county is instead carried through the {county} token in courtName and venueDescriptor, which is how the ND config handles the same problem.

counselFlags.statement: The static legal propositions this motion would assert about the effect of voiding and sealing — including that the proceedings may not be used against the defendant except to determine eligibility and that the participant need not disclose them (KRS 218A.276(10)), and that the court shall order the records sealed (KRS 218A.276(9)) — have not been ratified by counsel.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Ratify the fixed statements of legal effect the motion may make about KRS 218A.276(9) and (10).

counselFlags.statement: The required proposed order is official form AOC-334, Order Voiding Conviction and Sealing Records, Rev. 1-22, tendered with the motion. Lane C drafts no order text for it. This is a mandatory official-form handoff to the official-PDF overlay lane, and it is the same form the KRS 218A.275 track tenders — one acquisition serves both Kentucky void-and-seal tracks.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That AOC-334 overlay and field mapping is owned and completed by the official-PDF overlay lane, and that the single form is correctly parameterised for both the KRS 218A.275 and KRS 218A.276 branches.

counselFlags.statement: The offence list is fixed by KRS 218A.276(1) at marijuana, synthetic drugs and salvia possession. Nothing outside that list qualifies, and no argument by analogy to any other possession offence may be generated. The KRS 218A.275 track is the route for other controlled-substance possession convictions.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That screening routes any offence outside the KRS 218A.276(1) list away from this track rather than stretching it.

counselFlags.statement: No source read for this track says anything about the current legal status of marijuana, synthetic drugs or salvia in Kentucky. The motion must not argue that the conduct has been decriminalized, legalized or is no longer an offence; the only sourced basis is the fixed KRS 218A.276(1) list plus completion. qaProhibitedTerms bars 'decriminalized' and 'legalized'.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no legal-status or decriminalization argument is ever rendered on this track.

counselFlags.statement: No source read for this track states an accepted caption or format. What is sourced is that the motion is made in the original criminal case in the county of conviction, as motion type SA, and that no summons issues. The caption in this config is a token pattern built from those facts plus the participant's screening answers. The recorded venue says District Court is 'ordinarily' the court of conviction; the court level is nonetheless taken only from vmjCourtLevel.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: The caption and format Kentucky circuit court clerks accept for a KRS 218A.276(8) motion, since no official form exists for the motion itself.

counselFlags.statement: Whether this was a first conviction for this kind of possession is the participant's own statement of fact. Any dispute about first-offence status ends automated assistance. The motion states the participant's answer as the participant's own averment and asserts no first-offence conclusion of its own.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no pipeline stage derives, infers or asserts first-offence status from any record.

counselFlags.statement: Voiding under this section may occur only once for any person. A participant who has already had a conviction voided under KRS 218A.276 is excluded, and the packet asserts nothing about prior voidings beyond the participant's own answer to vmjPriorVoid.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That vmjPriorVoid is an eligibility gate and not merely a collected answer.

counselFlags.statement: The scope of the KRS 27A.099 exception, which keeps some records outside the sealing order, is an open research note. The motion and the participant copy say that records excepted by KRS 27A.099 are not reached; neither enumerates which records those are.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: The scope of KRS 27A.099 before any statement is made to a participant about which records survive sealing.

counselFlags.statement: A conviction voided under KRS 218A.276(8) can be expunged under KRS 431.078 with no five-year wait, which the registry records as the only route in Kentucky to same-year misdemeanor expungement. That is a downstream routing instruction, not relief requested in this motion, and it is stated in participant copy only.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That routing to the KRS 431.078 expungement track happens only after an order voiding the conviction is entered, never before — and that the 'only route to same-year expungement' characterisation is ratified before it is stated to a participant.

counselFlags.statement: This remedy seals; it does not expunge. The rendered motion must never use expungement vocabulary. The profile copy guardrail is directly on point: use Kentucky-specific remedy terminology and do not relabel every remedy as expungement.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That participant copy and rendered output for this track never promise erasure or destruction of records.

counselFlags.statement: Any participant who is not a United States citizen is a self-help stop condition on this track, because a voided conviction may still be a conviction for immigration purposes.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That screening stops on a non-citizen participant before any packet is produced.

counselFlags.statement: A participant choosing between void-and-seal and expungement is making a lifetime-consequence strategy decision and is a self-help stop condition. A clerk who demands a filing fee is also a stop condition: the Clerks' Manual records no filing fee for this proceeding.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That both stop conditions are wired, and that no fee figure of any kind is quoted to a participant.

counselFlags.statement: Court level, county, case number, judge, prosecutor identity, prosecutor position, filing date, service completion and hearing outcome are blank in every fixture and are never prefilled from any source. County, court level and case number reach the document only as the participant's own screening answers.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no pipeline stage populates court identity, prosecutor position, service completion or any outside-party act.

counselFlags.statement: Track legalStatus is 'legal_review_pending' and legalDesignStatus is 'legal_design_approved_with_limitations'. Runtime is disabled: counsel approved the design, not the produced document; output review, visual review and technical proof are all outstanding. implementationQueue is F_source_problem. This track carries no build blocker — unlike its KRS 218A.275 sibling.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Output review, visual review and technical proof before this pleading leaves internal review.

counselFlags.statement: All four official sources on this track carry sha256 null — AOC-334 Rev. 1-22, KRS 218A.276, KRS 27A.099 and the Kentucky Circuit Court Clerks' Manual (recorded only as the Circuit Court portal root). Staleness cannot be detected for any of them.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Capture hashes for all four official sources, and a direct URL for the Clerks' Manual rather than the portal root, before release.

counselFlags.statement: The compiled KY profile does not record this mechanism at all. Its five pathways are KRS 431.078, KRS 431.073, KRS 431.076 and two juvenile routes; the strings '218A.276', '27A.099' and 'AOC-334' appear nowhere in it. The committed Kentucky state pack likewise carries build metadata and the Nationwide inventory only. This track rests on the pinned registry entry.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether the KY compiled profile should be regenerated against a source corpus that includes Chapter 218A, so the void-and-seal mechanisms are visible to the engine.

rendererCompatibility.note: This config is data. It is written against the PleadingTrackConfig shape consumed by src/lib/record-clearing/renderers/custom-pleading-renderer.ts, but that renderer cannot yet consume it faithfully. The defects below were observed in a rendered sample of fixtures/canonical.json produced in this worktree. They are renderer/adapter defects, not data defects, and no source-faithful field has been altered to work around them.

adapterDefects.observed: Fields deliberately set to null under the sourced-content-only rule are printed literally as the text 'null' — the caption rendered "COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY,\n    null,", the parties block rendered "null is the Commonwealth of Kentucky.", and the verification clause rendered "I, [NAME], null that the statements ...".
adapterDefects.requiredAdapterBehavior: A null role, verb or label means the source does not state one. The adapter must omit the line or clause entirely, never stringify null. Null is the convention this artifact set is required to use for unsourced values; supplying a value instead would be invention.

adapterDefects.observed: A 'VI. VERIFICATION' section was emitted with a truth-of-statements clause, although this track's registry entry states "none required. The motion is not verified." and componentInventory marks verification absent.
adapterDefects.requiredAdapterBehavior: The renderer needs a way to suppress the verification section when verificationStatute.citation is null AND the source affirmatively states the filing is not verified. Rendering an unsourced verification clause into a Kentucky motion is exactly the invention this artifact set exists to prevent.

adapterDefects.observed: With usesCounty:true the renderer emitted "the Court of Common Pleas of EXAMPLE County, Pennsylvania" into a Kentucky motion.
adapterDefects.requiredAdapterBehavior: usesCounty is documented as a county-line flag but its true branch is hardcoded Pennsylvania text. This config sets usesCounty:false and carries the county through the {county} token instead. The renderer should separate 'this jurisdiction uses a county line' from 'this jurisdiction is Pennsylvania'.

rendererCompatibility.fixtureShapeNote: Fixture partyData uses the renderer's own field names (petitionerName, petitionerAddress, otherNamesUsed) so that fixtures are valid PleadingRenderInput. The movant/applicant role label comes from presentation.movantRole, not from the fixture key.
